subject.title: [Feature]: Slim the Skill Workshop system-prompt section; move mechanics into the tool schema

question: Should OpenClaw accept the slimmer Skill Workshop prompt/schema wording in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100481 as sufficient to preserve the governed proposal-routing contract?
rationale: This changes model-facing safety and product tone around generated skill writes, and the live issue is protected with the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Approve slim prompt after proof

options.title: Tighten wording first
options.body: Ask for one more explicit lifecycle/proposal-routing sentence before accepting the smaller prompt.

options.title: Keep current redundancy
